name: KPark
tagline: An assistant that shows live free parking in Kingston from street sensors and guides you to it.
problem: Drivers circle full lots near campus and arrive late.
solution: Pulls real sensor updates on free spots, prices and locations, filters for accessibility, EV charging and vehicle height, and answers chat requests for the best spot near a destination.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask where to park near a venue and get a route to a free spot.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “City of Kingston Prize Track” among 77 submissions.
Born from the team's own late arrivals to games.

lessons: A small, personal annoyance shared by a whole city makes a credible civic pitch.
